problem.label: WHY OUTDOOR COOLING IN QATAR
problem.headline: From May to October, Qatar's heat pushes people indoors.
problem.p1: With summer temperatures regularly exceeding 45°C, outdoor terraces, pool decks, gardens, and commercial seating areas become unusable for almost half the year.
problem.p2: For villa owners, that means five months of an empty garden. For restaurant operators, it means five months of lost covers. For hotels, it means closed pool decks when guests need them most.
problem.p3: High-pressure misting changes that. By atomising water at up to 70 bar, our Italian-engineered systems drop ambient temperatures by 10–15°C instantly — without wetting surfaces, furniture, or your guests.
problem.footnote: Cooling performance varies with ambient humidity. Verified in comparable Gulf climates.

benefits.label: WHY HIGH-PRESSURE MISTING
benefits.headline: Six reasons it works.
benefits.b1Body: Flash evaporation at 60–70 bar drops ambient air temperature instantly. Independently verified in Gulf climates — not a lab figure.
benefits.b2Body: Every system includes UV water sterilization. The mist around your guests meets drinking-water quality standards before it reaches the air.
benefits.b3Body: At 70 bar, water droplets are 10 microns — they evaporate before contacting surfaces. Tables, menus, and guests stay completely dry.
benefits.b4Body: 230V / 50Hz — Qatar mains voltage. No transformer required. Engineered for Gulf climate and power supply from day one.
benefits.b5Body: A full residential system draws under 200W. Running cost is a fraction of any comparable portable AC — which cannot cool outdoors anyway.
benefits.b6Body: Fabtech installs every system with trained in-house technicians. Spare parts stocked in Doha. Annual service contracts available.

objections.headline: Honest answers to the questions operators ask.
objections.q1: Will it wet my tables and menus?

objections.q2: Will it affect the food and drinks?
objections.a2: No. The mist evaporates in the ambient air and does not deposit moisture on served food or open drinks in normal operating conditions.

hero.label: INDUSTRIAL & ADIABATIC
hero.sub: At 45°C ambient, Qatar's air-cooled chillers run at 60–70% efficiency. Idrobase adiabatic pre-cooling systems restore capacity and cut energy bills — with no chiller modification required.

technical.label: THE TECHNICAL CASE
technical.headline: Pre-cool the inlet air. Recover the capacity.
technical.body: Air-cooled chillers and dry coolers reject heat to ambient air. In Qatar's peak summer (45–50°C), the chiller has to work substantially harder to reject the same heat load — consuming more energy and producing less cooling capacity. Idrobase's Fog Adiabatico system pre-cools the air entering the condenser coil by atomising fine water mist in front of the coil face. As the water evaporates, it absorbs latent heat and drops the incoming air temperature by 8–15°C.
technical.r5: No modification to existing chiller required
technical.r6: Typical installation: 1–2 days per chiller bank

range.label: KIT RANGE
range.headline: Fog Adiabatico — packaged kits
range.footnote: All systems include AISI 303 stainless steel distribution pipe, polyamide high-pressure pipe (100 bar rated), slip-lock connections, UV sterilizer, water inlet kit and pressure stabilizer.

Industrial facilities with roof-mounted DX condensers

pilot.label: THE MEASUREMENT OFFER
pilot.headline: We propose a monitored pilot installation.
pilot.body: Commission the system on one chiller bank, measure kWh consumption and cooling capacity before and after over a 30-day period at peak ambient conditions. The data tells the story. We stand behind the performance numbers.

hero.label: ABOUT FABTECH
hero.sub: From facility services to outdoor cooling — built on the same science of clean air and UV-treated water.

story.label: OUR STORY
story.headline: Where disinfection expertise meets outdoor cooling.
story.p1: Fabtech Services Trading & Contracting was founded in Qatar in 2017 with a simple mission: to keep Qatar's facilities clean, healthy, and well maintained.
story.p2: Over eight years we have served more than 500 clients across hospitality, residential compounds, commercial buildings, and healthcare facilities. We built our reputation in disinfection and air quality management — becoming one of Qatar's most active facility services providers during the COVID-19 period, deploying sanitization systems across hospitals, hotels, and public facilities.
story.p3: That disinfection and air quality background is what led us to outdoor cooling. The same science that governs indoor air quality — microdroplet size, UV sterilization, water purity, distribution engineering — governs high-pressure misting. When we evaluated which technology partner to work with, we chose Idrobase: the Italian manufacturer whose UV sterilization standard matches our own belief that the air around your guests should be clean, not just cool.

idrobase.label: THE IDROBASE PARTNERSHIP
idrobase.headline: Qatar's Official Idrobase Distributor.
idrobase.p1: Fabtech is Qatar's authorised dealer for Idrobase Group S.r.l., Borgoricco, Padova — founded 1986, one of Italy's leading manufacturers of high-pressure misting and fog systems. Every product we sell is manufactured in Italy, CE certified, and backed by Idrobase's international warranty and technical support network.
idrobase.p2: We made this choice deliberately. In a market where many suppliers source generic Asian-manufactured components and rebadge them, we chose to align with the most credible engineering-led brand available.

values.label: OUR VALUES
values.headline: Three commitments we don't compromise on.
values.v1Body: Every water system we install is UV sterilized as standard. Not optional. The air around your guests is treated to drinking-water quality standards.
values.v2Body: We recommend the right system for your space, not the most expensive one. Our survey is free and our advice is direct.
